node: AI-server passive components and board-level power delivery, including high-end MLCCs
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for AI-server passives and board-level power delivery into two lanes. Reference lane includes Murata as the most direct high-end MLCC context anchor and Vicor as a direct AI-processor power-delivery specialist. Underfollowed lane includes Vishay as a US-listed passive-components/MLCC candidate requiring AI-server qualification proof, and Bel Fuse as a smaller data-center power, magnetics, connectivity, and power-shelf supplier with plausible second-order exposure to AI rack power intensity. The core chokepoint remains a hypothesis: the bottleneck is not generic capacitors, but a narrow high-capacitance, low-ESR/low-ESL, high-reliability band plus nearby high-current power-delivery architectures.
